# A test raises an event through the target's override of it, on every
# target: dial's own trigger presses its button, which counts one, and each
# target's `func dial.change[platform](to)` sets the count it was handed and
# emits the event, so a count of 3 is the override's. testdata/trigger_override.sngl
# is the interpreter's half.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import bubbletea "sngl:platform/bubbletea"
import android "sngl:platform/android"
import gtk4 "sngl:platform/gtk4"
import none "sngl:platform/none"
import html "sngl:platform/html"
import fyne "sngl:platform/fyne"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component dial(:value int, @change(to int)) ui.node {
    ui.button #up(text="{value}", @click {
        value += 1
        change(value)
    })
}

component dial[html.platform](value, @change) {
    ui.button #up(text="{value}", @click {
        value += 1
        change(value)
    })
}

func dial.change[html.platform](to) {
    value = to
    change(to)
}

component dial[fyne.platform](value, @change) {
    ui.button #up(text="{value}", @click {
        value += 1
        change(value)
    })
}

func dial.change[fyne.platform](to) {
    value = to
    change(to)
}

component dial[bubbletea.platform](value, @change) {
    ui.button #up(text="{value}", @click {
        value += 1
        change(value)
    })
}

func dial.change[bubbletea.platform](to) {
    value = to
    change(to)
}

component dial[android.platform](value, @change) {
    ui.button #up(text="{value}", @click {
        value += 1
        change(value)
    })
}

func dial.change[android.platform](to) {
    value = to
    change(to)
}

component dial[gtk4.platform](value, @change) {
    ui.button #up(text="{value}", @click {
        value += 1
        change(value)
    })
}

func dial.change[gtk4.platform](to) {
    value = to
    change(to)
}

component dial[none.platform](value, @change) {
    ui.button #up(text="{value}", @click {
        value += 1
        change(value)
    })
}

func dial.change[none.platform](to) {
    value = to
    change(to)
}

component main ui.node {
    var n = 0
    var seen list[int] = []

    dial #d(:value=n, @change(v) { seen.push(v) })
    ui.text #shown(value="{n}")
}

func testATriggerRaisesTheEventThroughItsOverride(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.d.change(3)
    t.assert(c.n == 3)
    t.assert(c.seen.length() == 1 && c.seen[0] == 3)
    t.assert(c.shown.value == "3")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
